rationale: Luke brings full-stack AI/ML engineering and founding experience building adaptive learning platforms, while Louan is advancing deep learning methods for clinical neuroimaging at UCSF—their skill sets complement each other across ML infrastructure, computer vision, and applied research. Both are based in San Francisco and working at the intersection of AI and domain-specific problems; Luke's convictions around personalized learning at granular fidelity and Louan's work on weakly supervised methods for medical imaging suggest shared interests in making AI tools that solve real problems rather than hype.
intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Louan—you're both building applied ML systems in San Francisco, and your experience across generative AI, adaptive learning, and neuroimaging pipelines could spark some interesting ideas for the hackathon.
